playbook.headline: Leaning bullish. Watch R1 25,780: the call plan starts above it.

watch.name: R2
watch.why: Call target and strong resistance. Book profits on calls here.

watch.name: Last session high
watch.why: A break above often brings follow-through buying.

watch.name: R1
watch.why: Call trigger. A 15-minute close above this starts the CE plan.

watch.name: Pivot
watch.why: Stop-loss line for both plans. Above it buyers control the day, below it sellers do.

watch.name: Last session low
watch.why: A break below often brings follow-through selling.

watch.name: S1
watch.why: First support. Dips often find buyers here.

watch.name: S2
watch.why: Put target and strong support. Book profits on puts here.

watch.name: 200-day average
watch.why: Long-term trend line that large funds watch.

watch.name: 50-day average
watch.why: Medium-term trend line. Closing above or below it shifts the bias.

scenarios.when: Nifty closes a 15-minute candle above R1 25,780
scenarios.then: Buy an ATM call. Target R2 26,211, exit if Nifty falls back below the pivot 25,562.

scenarios.when: Nifty closes a 15-minute candle below S1 25,131
scenarios.then: Buy an ATM put. Target S2 24,913, exit if Nifty climbs back above the pivot 25,562. This goes against today's bias, so trade smaller or skip it.

scenarios.when: Nifty stays between S1 25,131 and R1 25,780
scenarios.then: Don't buy options. Premiums lose value every hour in a sideways market.

scenarios.when: Nifty opens more than 127 points (0.5%) away from 25,350
scenarios.then: Wait 15 to 30 minutes. Big gaps often partly fill. Enter only if price holds beyond the first 15-minute high (gap up) or low (gap down).

alerts.title: Broke above the 20-day high of 25,809
alerts.detail: Holding above 25,809 keeps the breakout alive, with R2 26,211 next. Falling back below it would make this a false breakout.

note.summary: Rule-based read of the evidence: ADX 46.4: strong trend, buyers stronger; Bearish engulfing; Bearish marubozu.

suggestions.title: Upside trigger above 25,768
suggestions.detail: A daily or 15-minute close above the resistance zone (2 touches) at 25,768 opens the next leg up. This goes against the current lean, so trade smaller.

suggestions.title: Downside trigger below 24,685
suggestions.detail: A close below the support zone (3 touches) at 24,685 opens room lower. This goes against the current lean, so trade smaller.

suggestions.title: Inside the range, stay patient
suggestions.detail: Between 24,685 and 25,768 there's no edge for option buyers; time decay works against you.

note.invalidation: A close beyond 25,768 or 24,685 against the lean.
